newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rodamco seals takeover of Cegep.
newsitem.headline: Rodamco seals takeover of Cegep.

text.p: Rodamco NV said on Friday it had finalised the acquisition of French property fund Cegep, first announced in July.

Rodamco, the property arm of the Robeco Group of investment funds, bought 95.52 percent of Cegep's ordinary shares and 99.89 percent of the unit's convertible bonds. The interest was bought from Geneurope Holding BV, Financiere Covest, Cofragep and Boucheries Nivernaises, it said in a statement.
Rodamco said it paid 250 francs per share and 313 francs per convertible, valuing the deal at more than 1.65 billion francs. Transfer of the shares and bonds took place today, it added.
Rodamco said Cegep's other shareholders and owners of convertible bonds would be given the opportunity to sell their stock and bonds at the same conditions.
Rodamco's advisor Lazard Freres & Cie has given a price guarantee for these shares and bonds.
Cegep's assets mainly consist of interests in large regional shopping centres in Lyon, Lille, Rouen and Paris and an office tower in Lyon.
